dogecoin.text: Vitalik Buterin is calling out Elon Musk for banning free speech, sparking a debate about the real meaning of free expression in the crypto universe. I guess we should just be thankful the banhammer doesn’t come with a side of Dogecoin. 🤷‍♂️ #crypto #FreeSpeechDebate

Dogecoin traders are getting giddy, predicting a wild 180% price rally if Bitcoin keeps flexing its muscles. Funny how these pups bark when the big dog barks, like they’re waiting for a *very* late dinner. 🐶 #crypto #DogecoinToTheMoon
